prompt: Ideas for poems and projects come to you while you are travelling, but they have vanished by the time you get home. Which habit best captures them?

options.text: Keep one notebook or phone note for ideas and jot a one-line version down straight away
Trust that you will remember the best ideas anyway
Stop whatever you are doing and develop each idea fully on the spot
Only allow yourself ideas when you are sitting at a desk

explanation: A single, always-available place for a one-line note takes seconds to use, so ideas are stored before they fade — without derailing whatever you were doing when they arrived.
